title: Integrity and Confidentiality
text: Personal data shall be processed in a manner that ensures appropriate security of the personal data, including protection against unauthorised or unlawful processing and against accidental loss, destruction or damage, using appropriate technical or organisational measures.

title: General principle for transfers
text: Any transfer of personal data which are undergoing processing or are intended for processing after transfer to a third country or to an international organisation shall take place only if the conditions laid down in this Chapter are complied with by the controller and processor.

title: Transfers or disclosures not authorised by Union law
text: Personal customer data must not leave the EU without approval. Any judgment of a court or tribunal and any decision of an administrative authority of a third country requiring a controller or processor to transfer or disclose personal data may only be recognised or enforceable in any manner if based on an international agreement.

title: Data Minimisation
text: Personal data shall be adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary in relation to the purposes for which they are processed.

title: Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten')
text: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller the erasure of personal data without undue delay, provided that deletion requires verified authorization, justification, and immutable audit logging.

title: Prohibition of Unauthorized External AI Transmission
text: Personal customer data, internal source code, and credentials must not be sent to unapproved external AI services or generative AI platforms. Only sanctioned AI tools behind approved gateways may process designated data classes.

title: Role-Based Access Control and Privilege Escalation
text: Only approved roles and authenticated employees may access customer records or change system configurations. Any privilege changes or elevated access grants require documented approval tickets prior to execution.

title: Bulk Export Anomaly Thresholds
text: Bulk exports of customer records exceeding the configured organizational threshold (e.g., 5,000 records) require secondary review and authorization to prevent data exfiltration.

title: Brute Force and Repeated Login Anomaly Detection
text: Repeated failed authentication attempts exceeding the configured threshold (e.g., 10 failed logins within 5 minutes) must trigger an immediate security alert and account review.

title: Off-Hours and Context-Dependent Access Review
text: Access to sensitive production databases outside normal operational working hours without prior declared business justification must be flagged for context-based supervisor review.
